Name: Windows Search
Description: Indexes files, e-mail, and other content to provide fast search results across Windows.
Notes: Disabling removes fast search/indexing; Start menu and file search fall back to slower on-demand search.

Name: SysMain (Superfetch)
Description: Preloads frequently used applications into memory to reduce load times.
Notes: Impact varies significantly with SSD vs HDD - can help on HDD, may add unnecessary background disk activity on SSD. Analyzer should check disk type before recommending.

Name: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry
Description: Collects diagnostic and usage data and sends it to Microsoft.
Notes: Low performance impact; disabling is primarily a privacy consideration rather than a performance one.

Name: Print Spooler
Description: Manages print jobs and interaction with installed printers.
Notes: Required for any printing. Has a history of security vulnerabilities (e.g. PrintNightmare) when no printer is actually in use.

Name: Xbox Game Save
Description: Syncs game save data for Xbox-integrated titles.
Notes: Keep for Gaming; safe to disable for non-gaming profiles with no measurable performance effect either way.

Name: Windows Defender Antivirus Service
Notes: Never recommend disabling. Only Windows Security Center-managed exclusions should ever be considered, and only with explicit, deliberate user action outside routine optimization.

Name: Windows Update
Description: Delivers Windows security patches and feature updates.
Notes: Do not recommend disabling; delivers security patches. A temporary pause during an active gaming session is a separate, narrower consideration outside a blanket disable recommendation.

Name: Background Intelligent Transfer Service
Description: Transfers files in the background for Windows Update and other applications.
Notes: Disabling can break update delivery and other apps that rely on background transfers.

Name: Fax Service
Description: Sends and receives faxes using a fax modem or shared fax device.
Notes: Rarely used on modern systems without a fax modem attached.

Name: Remote Registry
Description: Allows remote users to modify registry settings on this computer.
Notes: Disabled by default on most systems; increases attack surface if enabled without a specific administrative need.
